# Phosphor Icons Web 2.1.1

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@phosphor-icons/web/v/2.1.1
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Vendored light, bold, and fill styles used by the application. The upstream CSS
keeps its glyph mappings; font sources are limited to the bundled WOFF2 files.
Both frontends serve these assets from their own origin to comply with the
existing Content Security Policy and avoid runtime CDN dependencies.

Keep frontend/assets/vendor/phosphor/2.1.1 and
nextjs-frontend/public/assets/vendor/phosphor/2.1.1 in sync when upgrading.
